Title: TC_001: Verify CMS-configured bottom nav icon auto-plays Lottie animation on cold start
Steps:
1. Force-kill app
2. Launch app (cold start)
3. Observe bottom navigation Favourites icon
Expected Result: Favourites icon begins Lottie auto-play animation immediately after bottom nav renders on cold start
Preconditions: App force-killed; user logged in; CMS configured for Favourites icon animation; prefers-reduced-motion disabled

Title: TC_002: Verify animation plays exactly 2 loops (default CMS config) then stops
Steps:
1. Cold start app
2. Observe animating icon without interaction
3. Count completed animation loops
Expected Result: Animation plays exactly 2 full loops then stops; no additional loops begin
Preconditions: Cold start; CMS loopCount=2; animation not interrupted

Title: TC_003: Verify animation plays CMS-configured loop count (non-default)
Steps:
1. Configure CMS loop count to 3
2. Cold start app
3. Observe animation loops
Expected Result: Animation plays exactly 3 loops then stops per CMS configuration
Preconditions: Cold start; CMS loopCount=3

Title: TC_004: Verify icon returns to static unselected state after animation completes
Steps:
1. Cold start app
2. Allow auto-play animation to complete all loops
3. Observe icon visual state
Expected Result: Icon displays static unselected state after animation completes (not stuck mid-animation frame)
Preconditions: Cold start; animation allowed to finish without tap

Title: TC_005: Verify auto-play does not replay again within same app session
Steps:
1. Complete cold-start auto-play animation
2. Navigate across bottom nav tabs
3. Return to Home and other tabs
4. Observe animating icon
Expected Result: No auto-play animation replays during the same app session after initial cold-start trigger
Preconditions: Cold start completed; animation finished; session active

Title: TC_006: Verify correct icon animates per CMS configuration — Live TV
Steps:
1. Set CMS to animate Live TV icon
2. Cold start app
3. Observe bottom nav icons
Expected Result: Only Live TV icon auto-plays; other icons remain static unselected
Preconditions: Cold start; CMS animatedIcon=Live TV

Title: TC_007: Verify correct icon animates per CMS configuration — On Demand
Steps:
1. Set CMS to animate On Demand icon
2. Cold start app
3. Observe bottom nav
Expected Result: Only On Demand icon auto-plays animation
Preconditions: Cold start; CMS animatedIcon=On Demand

Title: TC_008: Verify correct icon animates per CMS configuration — My Account
Steps:
1. Set CMS to animate My Account icon
2. Cold start app
3. Observe bottom nav
Expected Result: Only My Account icon auto-plays animation
Preconditions: Cold start; CMS animatedIcon=My Account

Title: TC_009: Verify tapping animating icon stops Lottie animation immediately
Steps:
1. Cold start with Favourites animating
2. Tap Favourites icon before animation completes
Expected Result: Lottie auto-play animation stops immediately on tap; no further loop frames play
Preconditions: Cold start; animation in progress on Favourites

Title: TC_010: Verify selected state Lottie plays after tap during animation
Steps:
1. Cold start with icon animating
2. Tap animating icon mid-animation
3. Observe icon state
Expected Result: Selected state Lottie animation plays for tapped icon after auto-play stops
Preconditions: Cold start; animation in progress

Title: TC_011: Verify navigation to tapped tab when icon tapped during animation
Steps:
1. Cold start with Favourites animating
2. Tap Favourites during animation
Expected Result: App navigates to Favourites tab content screen
Preconditions: Cold start; animation in progress

Title: TC_012: Verify icon remains in selected highlighted state after tap during animation
Steps:
1. Tap animating icon mid-animation
2. Observe bottom nav icon state after navigation
Expected Result: Tapped icon remains in selected (highlighted) state on bottom navigation
Preconditions: Cold start; tap during animation

Title: TC_013: Verify animation continues when user taps non-animating icon before animation completes
Steps:
1. Cold start with Favourites animating
2. Before animation completes tap Live TV icon
3. Observe Favourites icon
Expected Result: Favourites auto-play animation continues until Favourites icon is selected; animation does not stop on other icon tap
Preconditions: Cold start; Favourites animating; animation not finished

Title: TC_014: Verify animation continues when user taps non-animating icon after animation completes
Steps:
1. Allow Favourites animation to complete
2. Tap On Demand icon
3. Observe Favourites icon
Expected Result: Favourites remains static unselected; no new auto-play starts; On Demand becomes selected
Preconditions: Cold start; animation completed; Favourites unselected

Title: TC_015: Verify animation stops only when configured animating icon is selected
Steps:
1. Cold start with Favourites animating
2. Tap Live TV then On Demand (non-animating)
3. Verify animation still running
4. Tap Favourites
Expected Result: Animation continues through non-animating tab taps and stops only when Favourites (animating icon) is selected
Preconditions: Cold start; Favourites animating

Title: TC_016: Verify minimizing app during in-progress animation — behavior on return to foreground
Steps:
1. Cold start with animation playing
2. Minimize app (do not force-kill) mid-animation
3. Return app to foreground
4. Observe animation state
Expected Result: Documented behavior verified: animation state on foreground return matches FSD (see BAQ-001 for Scope vs Assumption clarification)
Preconditions: Cold start; animation in progress; app minimized mid-animation

Title: TC_017: Verify no new auto-play trigger after animation completed and app backgrounded
Steps:
1. Complete cold-start animation
2. Minimize app
3. Return to foreground
4. Observe bottom nav
Expected Result: No new auto-play animation starts on foreground return when animation already completed in session
Preconditions: Animation completed; session flag set; app backgrounded without force-kill

Title: TC_018: Verify force-kill and relaunch triggers auto-play again
Steps:
1. Complete animation in session
2. Force-kill app
3. Relaunch app (cold start)
4. Observe configured icon
Expected Result: Auto-play animation triggers again on cold start after force-kill; session flag is reset
Preconditions: Previous session animation completed; app force-killed

Title: TC_019: Verify animation replay after tap-navigate-background-foreground sequence per Assumption
Steps:
1. Cold start with Favourites animating
2. Tap Favourites mid-animation
3. Navigate to another bottom nav tab
4. Background app
5. Return to foreground
6. Observe Favourites icon
Expected Result: Per FSD Assumption: animation is replayed on Favourites icon after background-to-foreground return in this sequence
Preconditions: Cold start; user taps animating icon mid-animation; navigates away; backgrounds

Title: TC_020: Verify navigating to auto-play icon tab selects the icon
Steps:
1. Cold start with Favourites configured to animate
2. Navigate to Favourites tab via bottom nav
3. Observe icon state
Expected Result: Favourites icon becomes selected when user navigates to that tab
Preconditions: Cold start; animation playing or completed; user on different tab

Title: TC_021: Verify returning to auto-play icon tab shows unselected state with no re-animation
Steps:
1. Complete cold-start animation on Favourites (unselected)
2. Navigate to Live TV tab
3. Navigate back to Favourites tab
4. Observe icon
Expected Result: Favourites icon is unselected (not highlighted) and no auto-play animation replays
Preconditions: User navigated away from auto-play icon after animation completed

Title: TC_022: Verify auto-play icon does not re-animate on multiple return navigations
Steps:
1. Complete animation
2. Switch between tabs 5 times including auto-play icon
3. Observe animation
Expected Result: Auto-play icon never re-animates on return navigation within same session
Preconditions: Animation completed once in session

Title: TC_023: Verify Home icon never receives auto-play animation
Steps:
1. Cold start app
2. Observe Home icon on bottom nav
3. Repeat with different CMS animated icon configs
Expected Result: Home icon never plays auto-play Lottie; remains in selected state as per FSD limitation
Preconditions: CMS may configure any icon; Home hardcoded selected on FE

Title: TC_024: Verify Home icon cannot be configured as animated icon from CMS
Steps:
1. Attempt CMS config for Home icon animation
2. Cold start app
3. Observe behavior
Expected Result: Home icon does not animate; FE hardcoded behavior prevents Home animation regardless of CMS
Preconditions: CMS user attempts Home icon animation config

Title: TC_025: Verify only one bottom nav icon animates at a time
Steps:
1. Cold start app
2. Observe all bottom nav icons during auto-play
Expected Result: Exactly one icon (CMS-configured) animates; all other icons remain static
Preconditions: CMS configured for single icon; cold start

Title: TC_026: Verify behavior when CMS configures multiple animated icons (no FE restriction)
Steps:
1. Configure CMS with animation for 2+ bottom nav icons
2. Cold start app
3. Observe which icons animate
Expected Result: Behavior documented per FSD: no FE restriction implemented; verify actual behavior and document for BA (see BAQ-002)
Preconditions: CMS configured with multiple icon animations

Title: TC_027: Verify graceful skip of auto-play when CMS animation config is missing
Steps:
1. Remove/clear animation config from CMS
2. Cold start app
3. Observe bottom nav
Expected Result: Auto-play is skipped gracefully; static fallback icons display; no crash or broken nav
Preconditions: CMS returns bottom nav without animation fields

Title: TC_028: Verify fallback static icons used when CMS config missing or app updated
Steps:
1. Simulate CMS missing animation Lottie URLs
2. Launch app
3. Observe bottom nav icons
Expected Result: Fallback static unselected icons display for all nav items; auto-play skipped
Preconditions: CMS unavailable or partial response after app update

Title: TC_029: Verify auto-play skipped when prefers-reduced-motion is enabled
Steps:
1. Enable prefers-reduced-motion on device
2. Cold start app with valid CMS animation config
3. Observe bottom nav
Expected Result: No auto-play Lottie animation starts; icons display static states respecting accessibility setting
Preconditions: Device accessibility: prefers-reduced-motion=ON

Title: TC_030: Verify auto-play works when prefers-reduced-motion is disabled
Steps:
1. Disable prefers-reduced-motion
2. Cold start with valid CMS config
3. Observe animating icon
Expected Result: Auto-play Lottie animation plays normally when reduced motion is not enabled
Preconditions: Device accessibility: prefers-reduced-motion=OFF

Title: TC_031: Verify unselected auto-play Lottie renders for Live TV icon
Steps:
1. Configure Live TV animation
2. Cold start
3. Verify Lottie renders without distortion
Expected Result: Live TV unselected auto-play Lottie renders correctly using integrated Lottie library
Preconditions: CMS animates Live TV; assets available

Title: TC_032: Verify unselected auto-play Lottie renders for On Demand Favourites and My Account
Steps:
1. Test each icon (Live TV On Demand Favourites My Account) as CMS animated icon
2. Cold start per config
3. Verify Lottie asset
Expected Result: Each icon type renders correct unselected auto-play Lottie from finalized asset set
Preconditions: CMS cycles through each animatable icon

Title: TC_033: Verify selected state Lottie available for all animatable icons from CMS
Steps:
1. Tap each bottom nav icon
2. Observe selected state Lottie/static icon
Expected Result: Selected state visuals render correctly for all icons using existing CMS selected assets
Preconditions: Selected icons already in CMS per prerequisites

Title: TC_034: Verify animation with minimum loop count of 1
Steps:
1. Set CMS loop count to 1
2. Cold start
3. Count loops
Expected Result: Animation plays exactly 1 loop then stops and returns to static unselected state
Preconditions: CMS loopCount=1

Title: TC_035: Verify handling of invalid CMS loop count (0 or negative)
Steps:
1. Configure invalid loop count in CMS
2. Cold start app
3. Observe behavior
Expected Result: App handles invalid loop count gracefully (skip animation or use default) without crash
Preconditions: CMS loopCount=0 or invalid value

Title: TC_036: Verify animation replays on background-to-foreground return per Assumption
Steps:
1. Cold start with animation
2. Background app without force-kill
3. Return to foreground
4. Observe animation
Expected Result: Per FSD Assumption: icon animation replays when user returns from background to foreground
Preconditions: Cold start; animation in progress or completed per assumption scenario

Title: TC_037: Verify no bottom nav animation on app version below feature release
Steps:
1. Install app version released before RT-1266
2. Launch app
3. Observe bottom nav
Expected Result: Bottom nav icons display without auto-play Lottie animation on older app versions
Preconditions: Pre-feature app build installed

Title: TC_038: Verify animation feature available after updating to feature release version
Steps:
1. Update app to version including RT-1266
2. Cold start
3. Observe configured icon
Expected Result: Auto-play animation feature is available after app update to feature release version
Preconditions: User updates from pre-feature to post-feature app

Title: TC_039: Verify no rotation of animations across multiple icons in single session
Steps:
1. Cold start app
2. Complete animation
3. Verify no second icon auto-animates in same session
Expected Result: Only one icon animates per session; no rotating animation across icons (out of scope)
Preconditions: CMS could configure multiple; single session

Title: TC_040: Verify CMS config change during active session does not hot-reload animation
Steps:
1. Cold start with Favourites animating
2. Change CMS animated icon to Live TV without restarting app
3. Observe bottom nav
Expected Result: Animation config does not hot-reload during active session; behavior unchanged until next cold start
Preconditions: Active session; CMS updated mid-session

Title: TC_041: Verify feature not available on WEB platform
Steps:
1. Open Tata Play on WEB browser
2. Log in
3. Observe bottom navigation
Expected Result: No bottom nav icon auto-play animation on WEB (mobile only per FSD out of scope)
Preconditions: User accesses Tata Play on WEB

Title: TC_042: Verify guest user bottom nav animation behavior
Steps:
1. Launch app as guest user
2. Observe bottom nav icons
3. Compare with logged-in user behavior
Expected Result: Guest user animation behavior matches BA-confirmed approach (see BAQ-003 and FSD Questions S.No 1)
Preconditions: Guest user (not logged in); guest nav hardcoded on FE

Title: TC_043: Verify guest user does not crash when animation feature enabled for logged-in only
Steps:
1. Launch as guest
2. Navigate bottom nav
3. Monitor for errors
Expected Result: App remains stable for guest users regardless of animation feature scope decision
Preconditions: Guest session; feature flag for logged-in users

Title: TC_044: Verify bottom nav list API returns animation Lottie URL for configured icon
Steps:
1. Capture bottom nav list API response on cold start
2. Locate configured animated icon entry
3. Verify animation fields
Expected Result: API response includes Lottie animation URL/asset reference for CMS-configured animated icon
Preconditions: Logged-in user; API returns animation config

Title: TC_045: Verify bottom nav list API returns configurable loop count
Steps:
1. Call bottom nav list API
2. Inspect animation configuration fields
3. Compare with CMS
Expected Result: API response includes loop count value matching CMS configuration (default 2 for first release)
Preconditions: Logged-in user; CMS loopCount configured

Title: TC_046: Verify API response when animation config absent — no animation fields or null
Steps:
1. Call bottom nav list API with no animation config
2. Inspect response
3. Verify FE handling
Expected Result: API returns valid bottom nav list without animation fields or with null/empty animation config; FE skips auto-play
Preconditions: CMS without animation configuration

Title: TC_047: Verify guest user bottom nav API vs hardcoded FE nav for animation
Steps:
1. Call bottom nav API as guest (if applicable)
2. Compare with logged-in API response
3. Document animation field presence
Expected Result: API/FE behavior for guest users documented per BA decision on animation for guest hardcoded nav
Preconditions: Guest user session

Title: TC_048: Verify API returns selected icon assets for all bottom nav items
Steps:
1. Call bottom nav list API
2. Verify selected and unselected icon assets for each nav item
Expected Result: All bottom nav items include selected icon assets already used in CMS as per FSD prerequisites
Preconditions: Logged-in user; standard CMS config

Title: TC_049: Verify existing bottom nav tab navigation unaffected by animation feature
Steps:
1. Cold start app
2. Tap each bottom nav tab sequentially
3. Verify screen loads
Expected Result: All bottom nav tabs navigate correctly to respective screens without regression
Preconditions: Logged-in user; animation enabled

Title: TC_050: Verify static bottom nav icons display correctly when animation skipped
Steps:
1. Launch app with animation skipped
2. Observe all bottom nav icons
3. Verify labels and icons
Expected Result: All bottom nav icons and labels display correctly without animation; no layout breakage
Preconditions: CMS config missing or reduced motion enabled

Title: TC_051: Verify bottom nav performance not degraded during Lottie animation
Steps:
1. Cold start with animation
2. Rapidly switch tabs during animation
3. Monitor UI responsiveness
Expected Result: No perceptible UI lag or jank attributable to Lottie auto-play animation
Preconditions: Mid-range test device; animation playing

Title: TC_052: Verify unrelated app features unaffected during animation playback
Steps:
1. Start animation on cold start
2. Use search playback notifications while animation plays
3. Verify core features
Expected Result: Core app features outside bottom nav animation work normally during animation playback
Preconditions: Logged-in user; animation in progress
